findings.problem: The hint glosses chat and discuss point to other words, quatschen or plaudern for chat and diskutieren or besprechen for discuss, so a learner could reasonably recall one of those instead of reden.
findings.fix: hint: talk with someone or about something (not sprechen)

back.target: to talk, to speak (with someone, about something)

note: Wovon redest du? is an equally common way to say the example, but Worüber redest du? is fine.
